name: Hoshaiah
title: Leader in Judah after the exile
summary: Hoshaiah was a prominent leader in Judah following the return from the Babylonian exile. He is best known for his participation in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah, and as the father of Azariah (or Jaazaniah), who was among those who turned to the prophet Jeremiah. He played a role in the religious and political life of the restored Jewish community.

keyEvents.title: The Dedication of Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Hoshaiah led half of Judah's leaders in the solemn procession at the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt wall.

keyEvents.title: Hoshaiah's Son Confronts Jeremiah
keyEvents.description: Azariah (Jaazaniah), son of Hoshaiah, was among those who accused the prophet Jeremiah of lying when he warned the people not to go down to Egypt after the fall of Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The People Ask Jeremiah to Intercede
keyEvents.description: The leaders of the people, including Hoshaiah son of Jezaniah, approached the prophet Jeremiah and asked him to pray to the Lord for guidance on their behalf.

keyEvents.title: The People Refuse to Obey God's Word
keyEvents.description: Despite Jeremiah's prophetic words, Hoshaiah son of Jezaniah and the other leaders refused to obey the Lord's command and instead went down to Egypt.
